1
Tu Bhi Dil Se Utar Na Jaye Kahin.
Aaj Dekha Hai Tujh Ko Dair Ke Bad.
Aaj Ka Din Guzar Na Jaye Kahin.
Na Mila Kar Udas Logon Se.
Husan Tera Bikhar Na Jaye Kahin.
Aarzo Hai Keh Tu Yahan Aaye.
Our Phir Umar Bhar Na Jaye Kahin.
Ji Jalata Hoon Our Sochta Hoon.
Raigaan Yeh Hunar Na Jaye Kahin.
Ayo Kuch Dair Ro Hi Lein Nasir.
Phir Yeh Darya Utar Na Jaye Kahin.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = 'src/data/lyrics/niyat-e-shauq-bhar-na-jaye-kahin-tajpoints-740c6c041da5c6f6effc.md'
old = subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+p], text=True)
new = Path(p).read_text()
_, meta, body = new.split('---\\n', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()
original = old.split('---\\n', 2)[2].strip().splitlines()
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman)
assert [line.strip().casefold() for line in roman] == [line.rstrip('.').casefold() for line in original]
source = body.strip().splitlines()
assert source[0] == '۱' and len(source) == len(roman) == 12
assert all(line and not line.endswith('.') and '\\u200c' not in line for line in source)
print('Verified one stanza and 11 corresponding verses, with all Roman wording preserved.')
PY"
